## What capability are you looking for?

Describe what you want to be able to do that you currently can't.

## Which piece does this touch?

- [ ] `modules/tool-computer-use` (the `computer` / `desktop` tools, platform backends)
- [ ] `modules/hook-computer-use` (the provider wire-format seam)
- [ ] Remote transport
- [ ] Human/agent coexistence
- [ ] Something else / not sure

## Platform relevance

Which platform(s) does this matter for — Windows, macOS, Linux, all, or platform-agnostic?

## Why this, and why not a workaround

Is there a way to achieve this today (even a clunky one)? What makes the current path
insufficient?

## Anything else

Design sketches, links to related discussion, or prior art welcome.
